\section{\texttt{answer-feedback submit}}
\label{cli:answer-feedback-submit}\index{CLI commands!answer-feedback submit}

Answer a question and save the human judgement for that answer.

\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=bash]

\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{QUESTION}] \texttt{str}. Question to answer and review.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Options}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}rating}] \texttt{HumanFeedbackRating}, required. Human rating for the generated answer.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}comment}] \texttt{str \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Optional human review comment.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}report-\allowbreak{}id}] \texttt{str \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Optional saved report id linked to this feedback.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}tenant-\allowbreak{}id}] \texttt{str}, default \texttt{'default'}. Tenant id for retrieval and feedback scoping.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}tag}] \texttt{list[str]\allowbreak{} \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Feedback tag. Repeat for multiple tags.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}store-\allowbreak{}path}] \texttt{Path}, default \texttt{Path('.\allowbreak{}artifacts/\allowbreak{}human\_\allowbreak{}feedback')\allowbreak{}}. Directory holding answer feedback JSON files.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}index-\allowbreak{}path}] \texttt{Path}, default \texttt{Path('.\allowbreak{}artifacts/\allowbreak{}vector\_\allowbreak{}store.\allowbreak{}json')\allowbreak{}}. Path to vector index.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}k}] \texttt{int}, default \texttt{4}. Number of chunks to retrieve.
\end{arglist}

\section{\texttt{benchmark}}
\label{cli:benchmark}\index{CLI commands!benchmark}

Benchmark indexing, embedding, retrieval, and agent latency.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=bash]
feedback-agent benchmark [OPTIONS]
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Options}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}queries}] \texttt{Path}, default \texttt{Path('examples/\allowbreak{}queries.\allowbreak{}jsonl')\allowbreak{}}. Path to JSONL benchmark queries.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}output}] \texttt{Path}, default \texttt{Path('.\allowbreak{}artifacts/\allowbreak{}benchmark\_\allowbreak{}results')\allowbreak{}}. Directory for benchmark\_results.json and .md.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}dataset}] \texttt{Path}, default \texttt{Path('data/\allowbreak{}sample\_\allowbreak{}feedback.\allowbreak{}csv')\allowbreak{}}. Feedback CSV used to build the index.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}repetitions}] \texttt{int}, default \texttt{5}. Measured repetitions per phase.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}warmup}] \texttt{int}, default \texttt{1}. Discarded warmup repetitions per phase.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}k}] \texttt{int}, default \texttt{4}. Number of chunks to retrieve.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Details}Runs fully locally with the deterministic provider and writes a JSON report plus a Markdown results table into the output directory.
\apifield{Source}\texttt{feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent.\allowbreak{}cli.\allowbreak{}benchmark}, \texttt{src/\allowbreak{}feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent/\allowbreak{}cli.\allowbreak{}py:903}~(\href{https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/feedback-intelligence-agent/blob/b6cbc710ffdfa5f26f700c999d594c67588c1e16/src/feedback_intelligence_agent/cli.py#L903}{online})

\section{\texttt{chat}}
\label{cli:chat}\index{CLI commands!chat}

Chat with the agent using persistent conversation memory.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=bash]
feedback-agent chat [OPTIONS]
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Options}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}message}] \texttt{str \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Single message for non-interactive mode; omit to start a REPL.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}conversation-\allowbreak{}id}] \texttt{str \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Conversation to continue; omit to start a new one.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}index-\allowbreak{}path}] \texttt{Path}, default \texttt{Path('.\allowbreak{}artifacts/\allowbreak{}vector\_\allowbreak{}store.\allowbreak{}json')\allowbreak{}}. Path to vector index.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}store-\allowbreak{}path}] \texttt{Path}, default \texttt{Path('.\allowbreak{}artifacts/\allowbreak{}conversations')\allowbreak{}}. Directory holding conversation JSON files.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}top-\allowbreak{}k}] \texttt{int}, default \texttt{4}. Number of chunks to retrieve.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}customer-\allowbreak{}segment}] \texttt{str \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Filter retrieved feedback by customer segment.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}tenant-\allowbreak{}id}] \texttt{str \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Filter retrieved feedback by tenant id.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}channel}] \texttt{FeedbackChannel \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Filter retrieved feedback by channel.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}min-\allowbreak{}rating}] \texttt{int \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Minimum feedback rating to retrieve.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}max-\allowbreak{}rating}] \texttt{int \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Maximum feedback rating to retrieve.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}created-\allowbreak{}after}] \texttt{datetime \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Only retrieve feedback created at or after this time.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}created-\allowbreak{}before}] \texttt{datetime \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Only retrieve feedback created at or before this time.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Details}With \texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}message} the command answers one message and prints a JSON response containing the answer and the \texttt{conversation\_\allowbreak{}id} to reuse. Without \texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}message} it starts an interactive REPL reading from stdin (finish with \texttt{exit}, \texttt{quit}, or end-of-input).
\apifield{Source}\texttt{feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent.\allowbreak{}cli.\allowbreak{}chat}, \texttt{src/\allowbreak{}feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent/\allowbreak{}cli.\allowbreak{}py:394}~(\href{https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/feedback-intelligence-agent/blob/b6cbc710ffdfa5f26f700c999d594c67588c1e16/src/feedback_intelligence_agent/cli.py#L394}{online})

Ask a question against the indexed feedback.

  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}channel}] \texttt{FeedbackChannel \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Filter retrieved feedback by channel.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}min-\allowbreak{}rating}] \texttt{int \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Minimum feedback rating to retrieve.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}max-\allowbreak{}rating}] \texttt{int \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Maximum feedback rating to retrieve.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}created-\allowbreak{}after}] \texttt{datetime \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Only retrieve feedback created at or after this time.
  \item[\texttt{-\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}created-\allowbreak{}before}] \texttt{datetime \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}. Only retrieve feedback created at or before this time.
\end{arglist}
